entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to return an item.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. I can definitely help with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Alex Diaz, order number is 77-5-B-9-1. It's for the VeloBand GPS Tracker.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 29th, which was 18 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It works fine. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I simply don't use it. Can I return it for a refund, yes or no?

I appreciate the directness, Alex. Let me check the specific policy for that device. One moment... Okay, so for the VeloBand Pulse, because the device activation links the hardware to a user's personal account, we have a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns. As we're on day 18, I am unable to process a refund.
Ten days? That's it? So I'm just out the money for a product I don't want? This is a waste of time.

I understand your frustration, and I do have another solution. We can't take the item back, but we have launched an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform where you can sell your band directly to another member of our community.
A resale site? Run by you?

That's right. Since it's an official VeloFit marketplace, buyers have confidence, and sellers often recoup most of their original cost, especially for a new device like yours. It's the best way to get your money back outside the return window.
Fine. That's better than nothing. How do I do it?
I can email you a direct link right now to get your listing started. It's a very straightforward process. The email is on its way to you.
Got it. That's all I need.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist with today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
